list.definition: SELECT name AS "__text", code AS "__value" FROM factories WHERE "isActive" = true ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT $__timeGroup(t."bucketStart",$__interval) tg, t."factoryId" fid, t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq,
           t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb, t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart")),
  fin AS (SELECT tg, fid, wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY tg, fid, wo)
  SELECT s.tg AS time, fa.name AS metric, (LEAST(100,100.0*SUM(s.rm)/NULLIF(SUM(s.pm),0)))*(LEAST(100,100.0*SUM(s.irm)/NULLIF(SUM(s.rm),0)))*(100.0*SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms)/NULLIF(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms)+SUM(s.sb),0))/10000 AS value
  FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.tg=s.tg AND f.fid=s.fid AND f.wo=s.wo
  JOIN factories fa ON fa.id=s.fid GROUP BY s.tg, fa.name ORDER BY s.tg

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT $__timeGroup(t."bucketStart",$__interval) tg, t."factoryId" fid, t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq,
           t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb, t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart")),
  fin AS (SELECT tg, fid, wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY tg, fid, wo)
  SELECT s.tg AS time, fa.name AS metric, SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms)+SUM(s.sb) AS value
  FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.tg=s.tg AND f.fid=s.fid AND f.wo=s.wo
  JOIN factories fa ON fa.id=s.fid GROUP BY s.tg, fa.name ORDER BY s.tg
